title: Interview: John Lennon for Palm Beach Daily News | 1974
content:
John Lennon gave an interview to Palm Beach Daily News on 28 December 1974.

He was holidaying in Palm Beach with Julian Lennon and May Pang in late December, staying at the Sun and Surf complex on Sunrise Avenue. The interviewer was Sally Blanchard, and Lennon was photographed for the feature by Bob and Ken Davidhoff.
